<div class="card-body">
'''Alter''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">意識操作</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらか選ぶこと。１：運命数を引く。運命数＜（場に出ている中で、最も能力値の高い自分のキャラクターの能力値）ならば、１つのエフェクトかウーティーニ・エフェクトをキャンセルする。２：今使用されたばかりの「感知」カードをキャンセルする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-234o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">フォースの使い手は、手をふれることなく相手に圧力を加え、自分の意志に屈服させることができる。信念を中傷されたベイダーがモッティを苦しめたように。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Mind Manipulation.

'''Card text:''' Choose one. 1: Draw destiny. If it is less than the ability of your highest-ability character on table, cancel one Effect or Utinni Effect. 2: Cancel a Sense card just played.

'''Lore:''' A Force user can pressure an opponent without touching them and make them submit. As when Vader, slandered in his faith, tormented Motti.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese numbers the two options and names 感知 for Sense.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Alter (Dark) (Premiere)|Alter]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 99. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
